title: A week after urging an Nvidia shake-up, Scott Bessent says Jensen Huang's return should depend on probes of its China chip sales and presses Nvidia for answers (Alan Rappeport/New York Times)
summary: Alan Rappeport / New York Times: A week after urging an Nvidia shake-up, Scott Bessent says Jensen Huang's return should depend on probes of its China chip sales and presses Nvidia for answers — The treasury secretary said on CBS that it was too soon to say if Jensen Huang should return as the company's chief executive.
